design_philosophy: A high-performance, command-center dashboard for Coke's water reticulation digital twin. It prioritizes data clarity, precise instrumentation visibility, and rapid anomaly detection. We use a technical 'Grid Borders' layout to expose the skeleton of the UI, giving it an industrial, rigorous feel. The AI Agent interface utilizes a 'Terminal/Retro-Futurism' micro-theme for distinct interaction.

spacing_and_layout.alignment: Optical alignment prioritized. Text and data points left-aligned. Metrics and values strictly aligned for scannability.

surface_styles.dashboard_cards: Grid Borders (Technical Look). Flat background (#121212), 1px solid border (rgba(255,255,255,0.1)), no shadow. On hover: border-color transitions to rgba(255,255,255,0.3).
surface_styles.ai_agent_panel: Retro-Futurism (Terminal Look). Deep black background (#0A0A0A), subtle Volt Blue border (border-[#007AFF]/50). Monospace font for queries.
surface_styles.header: Solid background (#0A0A0A) with a hard bottom border (rgba(255,255,255,0.1)).

motion.entrance: staggered fade-in for widgets (opacity 0 to 1, translate-y 4px to 0)
motion.data_update: subtle flash (bg-[#007AFF]/20 to transparent) when live data ticks
motion.alert_pulse: infinite pulse animation on critical alerts (shadow or border glow)

icons.usage: Use Phosphor Icons for a dense, professional dashboard look. Use 'duotone' or 'regular' weights.

component_rules.buttons: Flat, sharp corners (rounded-none or rounded-sm). Primary CTA in #007AFF, text white.
component_rules.inputs: Shadcn UI tailored to dark mode. 1px borders, no heavy shadows. Focus state: ring-2 ring-[#007AFF].
component_rules.tables: Shadcn UI Table. Dense padding (py-2), monospaced numbers for tabular data.
component_rules.badges: Sharp corners. Colors map strictly to status (e.g., green for Online/Compliant, red for Offline/Out-of-spec).

pfd_diagram.description: The main Process Flow Diagram for the water reticulation system. This should be the centerpiece of the digital twin visualization.

company_logo.description: Coke company logo for the header navigation.

testing_attributes.requirement: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid. Format: kebab-case, role-based.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup standard React/Vite/Tailwind project with Shadcn UI primitives (cards, inputs, buttons, tables, badges).
2. Install and configure fonts (Chivo, IBM Plex Sans, JetBrains Mono) from Google Fonts in index.css.

3. Implement the layout using the 'Control Room' grid strategy. The PFD diagram image should be large and central, potentially with overlaid absolutely positioned status dots (green/red) to simulate a 'live' twin.
4. Build the Agentic AI interface as a persistent side panel or terminal-like section using a monospace font and electric blue accents.
5. Mock real-time data for Flow, Pressure, and Quality (pH, conductivity, chlorine) with auto-updating intervals to demonstrate 'live' capabilities.
6. Include a dedicated section for Anomaly/Leak detection and Compliance alerts, styled distinctly in red/orange.
7. Strictly apply the color palette and typography hierarchy. Do not use Inter for headings.
8. Ensure all clickable items and key metrics have appropriate data-testid attributes.
